Offers of Estab lished vendors with OFK or sister ordnance factories for the item ‘’ SET OF IGNITER TOP & BOTTOM CLOTH BAG (EMPTY) (LF-9911358667)’’ shall be rejected during t echnical evaluation i.e. established sources shall not be allowed to participate in SDOTE Bid. 2- Financial turn over criteria: The bidders to submit turn over certificate/balance she et/ITR duly certified by recognised chartered accountant for past 03 years as docume ntary evidence. MSE’s & Start-ups are exempted from financial turnover criteria subj ect to subject to meeting of quality & technical specifications and on submission of v alid Udyam Registration Certificate/ Certificate of Recognition. 3- If any firm is found as debarred for subject item at any stage before placing of sup ply order, Bid of the firm will not be considered for further evaluation. 4- Bidders have to submit duly filled vendor registration form including all the re quired details & requisite documents for Capacity verification through vendor re gistration facility available at vendor.munitionsindia.in before tender opening d ate else its offer will not be considered. In case the online link does not work then the firm has to submit duly filled & sig

ned VRRF including all the required details & requisite documents for Capacity v erification along with the Bid else the offer of the Bidder will not be considered. Further the Bidder also has to pay requisite application fee along with 18% GST for item registration through online mode only and upload the payment receipt along with the Bid. The format of VRRF and payment details (i.e. fees amount & Bank account details) is available in “Buyer uploaded ATC document” section of t he Bid Document. 5. Inspection to be carried out as per inspection document i.e. QAP, Specification & D rawings as part of TE & Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent along with the Suppl y. The Material will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the So le Criteria for acceptance of the Item. Place of Inspection & Authority:- at O F Khamaria, Raw Material/Advance Sample/Bulk Quantity: CGM/(OF) KHAMARIA or his authorized representative. 6. Bidder has to submit the MII document/certificate mentioning the %age of local co ntent of material to be supplied. 7. Bidder has to submit Udyam Registration Certificate for availing Purchase preferen ce clause of Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs). 8. The firm already holding one SDOTE supply order is also not allowed to participate in other SDOTE for same item, floated by same or any other Factory. 9. Compliance statement is enclosed herewith. Bidder has to submit this compliance statement completely filled & duly signed with seal of the firm. 10. NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to be uplo aded with bid: (i). I M/s. ....... hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provision, s pecification, plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party d uring and after expiry of Contract. (ii). If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 11. A Model ECS Mandate Format is being uploaded with the Bid. The Bidders are req uested to submit this Mandate Format during tender finalization i.e. the firm has to s ubmit completely and correctly filled Mandate Format at the time of supplying the m aterial. 12. DP shall include supply of full order including all the inspection process involving raw material inspection, stage/final inspection before bulk supply as per drawing and specification. 13. Advance sample as per QAP/Drawing/specification. Within 2 months of placement of supply order the firm has to submit 10 nos. (tentative & may subject to change) as advance sample for approval before bulk supply. 14. Performance Security Deposit/EPBG in favour of “Munitions India Limited O F Kha maria” is to be submitted by the supplier within 30 days from the date of award of co ntract as per TE terms & conditions if contract value (including all taxes) exceeds tha n 5 lakhs. 15. Unloading/Loading of dispatched material will be done by Store Section/OFK’ s hired labourers. The charges of the same will be deducted @ Rs 220/ton from

the regular bills of firm. NOTE: Bidders may please note that GEM is capturing & showing the IP addresses used by the Buyer and the Bidder(s)/Seller(s). The received bids having matching/common IP address with either Bidder(s)/Seller(s) or Buyer, shall be outrightly rejected & shall not be considered for further evaluation. . 7.
